resources.name: public-apis
resources.purpose: Discover public API and MCP server candidates by category.
resources.auth: Not applicable to the directory; individual providers vary.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Git repository / Markdown catalog; not a callable API endpoint.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Not applicable to the directory; individual providers vary.
compatible_work_ids: ROOM-HOP-wide discovery; individual integrations must name their owning Work
constraints: Catalog listing does not prove provider availability, safety, cost, license, or compatibility.
Repository MIT license does not replace individual provider terms.
Do not store credentials in W116.

resources.name: SSI FastConnect API
resources.purpose: Vietnam equities market data, OHLCV, indices, corporate actions, WebSocket streaming; the same platform also documents account and order-management operations.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: REST JSON and WebSocket; documented SDKs include Python, Node.js, Java, C#, Go.
resources.auth: API Key + Secret; JWT. Trading token requires OTP.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Registration and access conditions apply; inspect current SSI terms and rate-limit headers.
compatible_work_ids: Owning market-data/integration Work to be assigned
constraints: Separate read-only market-data scope from trading scope.
Trading endpoints can place/amend/cancel orders and access account data; do not enable or expose them to general Agents.
Never store API secrets or OTP in W116 or Git.

resources.name: FRED API
resources.purpose: Retrieve macroeconomic and financial time series from FRED and ALFRED, including series observations, releases, vintages and revisions.
resources.pricing_or_quota: API key registration; check current service limits.
constraints: Record series ID, units, frequency, seasonal adjustment, observation date and release/vintage context.
Do not treat revised historical data as the originally published value.

resources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs
resources.purpose: Access public company submissions, filing histories and XBRL company facts for fundamental and regulatory research.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: HTTPS JSON APIs and EDGAR filing data.
resources.auth: No API key for public data; clients must identify themselves with a compliant User-Agent.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public access; comply with SEC fair-access guidance and current request limits.
constraints: Respect SEC fair-access rules and request throttling.
Parse XBRL contexts, units, periods and amendments carefully; filings are not investment recommendations.

resources.name: CCXT
resources.purpose: Unified library for public market data across 100+ crypto exchanges; supports tickers, order books, trades and OHLCV. Also exposes private account and trading methods.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, C#, Go, Java and Rust; REST and exchange-specific WebSocket support.
resources.auth: Public market-data methods often need no key; private account/trading methods require exchange-specific credentials.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Open-source MIT; exchange rate limits and product/API conditions apply.
constraints: Private API methods include orders, transfers and withdrawals; keep disabled for general Agents.
Respect per-exchange rate limits, terms, geography and product availability.
Never store exchange keys in W116.

resources.name: fin-data-mcp
resources.purpose: Community MCP server describing a unified surface over equity, options, FX, crypto, commodities, macroeconomic and filing sources.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: MCP server; repository describes TypeScript implementation and multiple provider adapters.
resources.auth: Varies by provider; some sources public, optional providers require API keys.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Depends on upstream provider and optional credentials.
compatible_work_ids: Potential finance research Agent after code/security review
constraints: At inspection repository showed 4 stars and 1 commit; treat as low-maturity candidate, not production-ready.
Audit dependencies, code, provider behavior, licensing and tests before installing.
No trading or private account permissions.

resources.name: awesome-finance-mcp
resources.purpose: Discover MCP servers for finance Agents, including market data, trading research and financial-data connectors.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: GitHub Markdown directory; not an executable MCP endpoint.
resources.auth: Not applicable to directory; individual projects vary.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Not applicable to directory; individual projects vary.
constraints: Directory listing does not establish maintenance, safety, licensing, provider availability or production readiness.

resources.name: Frankfurter API
resources.purpose: Retrieve historical and current reference exchange rates sourced from central-bank data, including ECB reference rates.
resources.auth: No API key according to public documentation.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public service; verify current limits and data update schedule.
constraints: Reference rates are not necessarily executable trading quotes or intraday rates.
Store source date and base/quote currency.

resources.name: World Bank Indicators API
resources.purpose: Retrieve cross-country development and macro indicators, including GDP and other economic series.
resources.auth: Public indicator endpoints generally do not require an API key.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public API; verify current service conditions.
constraints: Check indicator definitions, units, country coverage, frequency and publication lag.

resources.name: Cổng Dịch vụ công Quốc gia
resources.purpose: Tra cứu thủ tục hành chính, dịch vụ công, cơ quan thực hiện, hướng dẫn hồ sơ và theo dõi trạng thái hồ sơ theo mã; thao tác nộp hồ sơ yêu cầu tài khoản/xác thực.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Web portal; public information lookup and authenticated citizen/business workflows.
resources.auth: Public lookup; account and identity/signature authentication for personal hồ sơ workflows.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Fees depend on the administrative procedure; portal access conditions apply.
constraints: Portal is a user-facing workflow, not a documented open API.
Agents must not submit applications, make declarations or pay fees without explicit authorization and user review.
Verify current competent authority, forms, fees and effective dates.

resources.name: Cơ sở dữ liệu quốc gia về văn bản pháp luật
resources.purpose: Tra cứu văn bản quy phạm pháp luật, toàn văn, thuộc tính, lịch sử hiệu lực, văn bản liên quan and downloadable files.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Public web portal; HTML/PDF/DOC downloads; no public API contract verified.
resources.auth: Public document lookup; some advanced services may vary.
constraints: Capture document number, issuing body, promulgation/effective dates, status and amendment history.
Do not infer current validity from a search snippet; open the official record.
Not a verified API; no automated bulk scraping assumed.

resources.name: National Public Investment Information System
resources.purpose: Official information system/database for public investment programs, projects and annual/medium-term plans; public-facing discovery and access scope must be checked.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Government information system/portal; no public API contract confirmed in this review.
resources.auth: Public pages may be accessible; system operations/accounts and data submission are controlled.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Not established; verify system access and data-sharing terms.
constraints: Do not assume database is openly downloadable or API-accessible.
Separate public project information from internal/controlled planning and disbursement records.
Use official system data as source of record where legally designated; preserve as-of date and project identifiers.

resources.name: Vietnam National E-Procurement System (VNEPS)
resources.purpose: Search public procurement notices, contractor/investor selection plans, bidding packages and project information.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Web portal with search interface; public API not verified.
resources.auth: Public search; account/signature may be required for participation and submission.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Search access and bidding fees/conditions depend on service and current rules.
constraints: Search results are not proof of award validity; inspect notices, amendments and award decisions.
No bid submission, digital signing or account actions by Agent without explicit approval.
Capture bid notice number, owner, deadlines, status and source timestamp.

resources.name: Cơ sở dữ liệu quốc gia về hoạt động xây dựng
resources.purpose: Official construction activity information/database intended to support construction-sector data, information sharing and analytical applications.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Government web system; public API/access model not verified.
resources.auth: Access levels and account requirements to be confirmed.
constraints: Do not infer public access or API availability from system existence.
Verify data scope, permissions and update frequency before integration.
Construction records may include controlled or project-sensitive information.

resources.name: CEMIA — construction norms, prices and indices information system
resources.purpose: Construction norms, construction prices, direct cost element prices and construction price indices for estimating and managing construction investment costs.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Official information system; public data/API interface not verified.
resources.auth: To be confirmed by the system owner.
constraints: Record province, effective period, work type, unit and source decision for every cost value.
Do not mix announced official norms with market quotations.
Confirm export/API availability and update cadence before integration.

resources.name: NSO Vietnam — health statistics
resources.purpose: Official statistical tables for health facilities, hospital beds, doctors, medical staff and health indicators by time/administrative area.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Web statistical tables and downloadable materials where provided; API not verified.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public statistical portal; verify reuse terms per dataset.
compatible_work_ids: Health statistics and policy analysis Work
constraints: Aggregate statistics only; not patient-level medical records.
Preserve year, geography, indicator definition, unit and revision notes.
Do not use for diagnosis or individual treatment recommendations.

resources.name: NSO Vietnam — education statistics
resources.purpose: Official statistical indicators for schools, classes, classrooms, teachers, pupils, enrollment and education access.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: Web statistical tables and indicator definitions; API not verified.
resources.pricing_or_quota: Public statistical portal; verify reuse terms per dataset.
constraints: Preserve academic year/reference period, geography, indicator definition and unit.
Distinguish official statistical series from school-level operational records.
No student personal data is included in this resource record.

resources.name: 64 quẻ Kinh Dịch — Nhật Nguyệt dataset
resources.purpose: Structured Vietnamese reference table for all 64 hexagrams with Vietnamese/Han names, upper/lower trigrams and image; available as CSV/Hugging Face dataset.
resources.protocol_or_endpoint: CSV dataset / Hugging Face datasets; no hosted inference API required.
resources.pricing_or_quota: CC BY 4.0 according to dataset publisher; attribution required.
compatible_work_ids: I Ching knowledge and retrieval Work
constraints: Reference data for names and hexagram structure; not a complete authoritative corpus of all commentaries.
Preserve original text, source edition and attribution when extending.
Separate classical source text, later commentary, modern interpretation and generated AI interpretation.
